correctness.rationale: Kreweras block-profile enumeration gives exactly the same multiset-of-part-sizes law as a uniform ordered positive composition of n into k parts. Marking a size-s part gives p_s=C(n−s−1,k−2)/C(n−1,k−1); under its size bias the other k−1 parts have n−s total and singleton mean (k−1)(k−2)/(n−s−1). This produces the asserted covariance k(k−1)p_s[ks−2(n−1)]/[(n−1)(n−s−1)] and sign crossing. Fixed-s binomial-ratio asymptotics give the density limit. Independent exhaustive noncrossing partition enumeration for n=5..8 reproduced conditional covariances. Correctness is established but does not establish originality relative to the stronger prior joint profile distribution.
residual_risks: The entire block-size profile law is classical and dominates the conditional covariance computation. Mathematical correctness and a meaningful sign boundary do not make this a scientifically original claim under the required implication test.
